market_summary: During the London session, EURUSD and GBPUSD are consolidating inside their respective Value Areas just above their VWAP/EMA50 baselines with sub-1.0 RVOL and mixed CVD momentum. BTCUSD remains structurally bearish beneath VWAP and EMA50, grinding along lower Value Area support without decisive volume expansion. All three symbols lack high-probability breakout confluence, warranting a disciplined HOLD stance across the board.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10773, VAH 1.10981) and resting slightly below POC 1.10946. CVD is BULLISH (+3,833) with a positive slope (+1009.55). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price trades above upward-sloping VWAP (1.10849) and EMA50 (1.10881). ATR channel is mid-to-upper, but volume confirmation is lacking with RVOL at 0.727 (no yellow spike). Resistance lies at Session High 1.10988 and S/R 1.11007. Given price is compressed directly under POC and VAH without breakout volume, mean-reversion chop inside the Value Area is favored. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish / holding above VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / holding near POC 1.10946 below Session High

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593, VAH 1.32797) and positioned below POC 1.32738. CVD is BEARISH (-2,298) with a mild positive slope, diverging from the current price holding above VWAP (1.32662) and EMA50 (1.32694). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Candles are mid-channel within the ATR bands with low volume (RVOL 0.66). Nearby support is at S/R 1.32661 and resistance at Session High 1.32809. Conflicting signals between bearish CVD and price holding baseline baselines with no volume trigger warrant staying flat. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral / hovering near VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside the lower bound of Value Area below POC 73541.61, testing breakdown below VAL 73397.14. CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with flat slope, agreeing with the prevailing downtrend. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is firmly below VWAP (73619.42) and EMA50 (73631.01). ATR channel shows compression near the lower band (73123.59). RVOL is normal at 1.065 with no yellow volume spikes. Signal candle closed below EMA20 and forming bar is breaking under S/R 73386.8 toward S/R 73284.6 and Session Low 73166.0, but lack of volume expansion keeps risk high for clean continuation. GEX is null.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish / trading well below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection / rejected from VAL 73397.14 and S/R 73386.8
